context: Request: executed credit agreements from the firm's deals valued over $1 billion, as comparables. Rubric: 1003-00003 (Harrowgate PE / VeloPay), 1005-00001 (Nexford Industrial), 1041-00003 (Solara Digital / Cloudium), each with its executed credit agreement, plus a precision criterion. Near misses the runs weighed: 1043-00001 (Ironhaven, $950M TLB), 1021-00001 (Verimark, $700M refinancing against a $3.1B appraised portfolio), 1031-00004 (Hudson Yards West, appraisal-based).

divergence: All three runs passed. The shared procedure: store-wide file-name searches for credit-agreement and financing names, an extraction scan for value terms (timeouts in every run), reads of the executed agreements and deal-value documents of a dozen candidates, and exclusion of facilities whose deal value is under the threshold. Reviews shaped each run: in T0 the screening review caught two facilities whose matter numbers were swapped after parallel reads, and the agent listed the folders and fixed the pairing; in T1 a review questioned excluding the near-threshold facility, and the agent read further and kept the exclusion; in T2 the write counted a refinancing that clears the threshold only on appraised value, three reviews flagged it, and the fifth check stage moved it out of the count. Label notes were ignored in T0 (once), T1 (twice) and T2 (once).
